study type: Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT), Longitudinal cohort study
exposure: Probiotic supplementation (Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis BB-02, Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis BB-12, Streptococcus thermophilus TH-4)
Timing of probiotic supplementation initiation (before 5 days from birth)
outcome: Detection of Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis in infant gut
Detection of Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis in infant gut
Detection of Streptococcus thermophilus in infant gut
cohort: A cohort of very preterm infants participating in a blinded randomized controlled trial.
finding: Probiotic supplementation with B. longum subsp. infantis BB-02, B. animalis subsp. lactis BB-12, and S. thermophilus TH-4 enhances the presence of these probiotic species in the gut microbiota of very preterm infants during and after supplementation, with earlier commencement associated with increased detection over the study period.
followup_time: Up to 23 months after supplementation ended
